signal: Dealerslink launched its AI Stocking feature plus ReconCloud 2.0 and OBD Scanner in early 2025, positioning as the fastest-growing inventory management company.

email.body1:
John, saw Dealerslink roll out AI Stocking and ReconCloud 2.0 to dealers this year.

Shipping new AI features usually opens more in-market dealers than the team can cover in the Mountain region, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

With new product driving demand, the regional pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many dealer meetings the Mountain region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other dealer-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product rollout season is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your dealer motion? I will tailor it to the Mountain region either way.
